This YES/NO value will define whether SSI configuration values are loaded from the Configuration System, or from the SSI tables.  The various maintenance programs have been modified to allow maintenance of the SSI programs if the value is NO, and to display the Config values if the value is YES.  The actual interface functions are conditioned to execute cinsistent with this paradigm.  This is being introduced so that testing can occur in isolated environments without affecting the performance and bahavior of the SSI in other environemnts.  It is intended that this be a transitional value.  Once the code changes are moved to production on FCB, the usage of this flag should be elimiinated, and only Config values should be used to control the beavior of the SSI.
Currently PGP is the only encryption method set up.
